title: MCP connection without authentication or over cleartext
message: The MCP server entry 'search' in .cursor/mcp.json uses an HTTP transport at http://mcp.example.com/mcp, over cleartext http:// to a non-loopback host. No authentication setting (headers, auth block, bearer/OAuth) was found in this config entry.

evidence.description: MCP client config: Cursor project config (.cursor/mcp.json); top-level 'mcpServers' object with server entries

Looked for: headers carrying credentials (Authorization, *token*, *key*, cookies) or a variable reference, an auth/oauth block, bearer/token/apiKey keys, a headersHelper, user-info in the URL, a credential query parameter. Found: none

remediation: Use https:// for remote MCP servers and configure authentication (an Authorization header from an environment variable or input, or the client's OAuth support).
